business_summary: IDEA Consultants,Inc. provides integrated consultancy services on social infrastructure development and environmental conservation projects in Japan and internationally. The company offers research, planning, designing, managing, evaluating, and consulting services related to construction and environmental conservation and improvement; environment work related services, such as surveys, forecasts, analysis, impact assessments, and environmental conservation measures; and physical and chemical analysis, and testing of water quality, air quality, soil, waste, tap water, food, etc. It also manufactures, sells, and leases environmental research and analysis equipment; provides industrial and domestic waste recycling, building and structure design and management, and civil engineering and construction work services; and engages in surveying and geological surveys, as well as real estate acquisition, sales, leasing, brokerage, maintenance, and management services. In addition, the company purchases and sales machinery, equipment, parts, and tools; provides staffing services; and produces and sells honey, royal jelly, pollen, etc. Further, the company offers environmental consulting services, including environmental assessment/environmental planning, conservation, restoration, and creation of the natural environment, environmental survey, chemical analysis and risk assessment, life science, and sustainability management support; construction consulting services comprising land conservation, transportation/logistics infrastructure, urban and regional development, and disaster response and recovery/reconstruction; and information system, such as disaster prevention/environment/construction system development, system operation support, meteorology, disaster prevention, and life information service, as well as infrastructure management services. The company was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Setagaya, Japan.
business_summary_ko: IDEA 컨설턴트, Inc. 일본 및 해외의 사회 기반 시설 개발 및 환경 보전 프로젝트에 대한 통합 컨설팅 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 건설, 환경 보전 및 개선과 관련된 연구, 계획, 설계, 관리, 평가 및 컨설팅 서비스를 제공합니다. 조사, 예측, 분석, 영향평가, 환경보전조치 등 환경업무 관련 서비스 수질, 대기질, 토양, 폐기물, 수돗물, 식품 등에 대한 물리적, 화학적 분석 및 테스트를 수행합니다. 또한 환경 연구 및 분석 장비를 제조, 판매 및 임대합니다. 산업 및 생활 폐기물 재활용, 건물 및 구조물 설계 및 관리, 토목 공학 및 건설 작업 서비스를 제공합니다. 측량, 지질조사, 부동산 취득, 매매, 임대, 중개, 유지관리 서비스 등을 영위하고 있습니다. 또한 회사는 기계, 장비, 부품 및 도구를 구매 및 판매합니다. 인력 서비스를 제공합니다. 꿀, 로얄젤리, 꽃가루 등을 생산, 판매하고 있습니다. 또한, 환경 컨설팅 서비스도 제공하고 있습니다.
